rationale.conceptual: The method is a standard curve-fitting exercise using a published model (Wachtman-type with Debye energy). No novel algorithms or deep domain-specific derivations are required; it’s a textbook application of least-squares fitting.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of two simple steps (compute volume expansion, then fit parameters) that could be done in a single script. No external tools or complex orchestration are needed; only standard Python libraries.
